output.summary: Group ticket time rose about 4 minutes at all nine sites in October 2024, as the board's own station study projected. The board explicitly accepted that cost and set a 19-minute ceiling. Satisfaction has risen since, and speed of service is unchanged. Riverside is a separate local problem. Its ticket time jumped after Delgado left in August 2026 and the position stayed unfilled, while the group transfer requests were deferred. Group line-cook turnover is falling, so a spreading staffing problem is not supported. The June hours cut hit all four Riverside cooks and followed group labor policy, so the GM is not clearly at fault. Recommend filling the Riverside vacancy and keeping the scratch menu. Do not adopt frozen components or a 12-minute bonus target, and do not replace the GM.
